MAMMON — Money Acquisition, Monetisation & Making-Ends-Meet Operations Network
Private cloud9 / EDEN App for income-generation campaigns and economic
opportunity strategy.

MAMMON owns strategy/campaign intelligence and monetisation.
HERMES owns jobs/opportunities and pursuit records.
MONETA owns financial semantics/state.
ARGOS verifies evidence.
CONDUCTOR orchestrates.
BIFROST resolves interoperability/providers.
HEIMDALL presents/configures the MAKE MONEY Workspace.

Pipeline:
DISCOVER → VERIFY → MODEL → STRATEGIZE → RESPOND → WIN → PLAN → EXECUTE →
ADAPT → VALIDATE → DELIVER → INVOICE → COLLECT → LEARN.

WORKFLOW STEPS ARE CAPABILITY REQUESTS, NOT JUST TEXT IN A TO-DO LIST.
BRIDGED ≠ DEPENDENT.
